description: This file defines a function to make a chat completion request to OpenAI's API, with streaming support, progress tracking, and handling of various optional parameters such as model, tokens, and callbacks for UI updates, reasoning content, timing, search results, and image handling.

methods.name: makeOpenAIChatCompletionRequest
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous chat completion request to OpenAI, streams responses, handles various data types such as text, images, reasoning content, and search results, and invokes provided callbacks for UI updates and metrics.
